name: second-brain
description: Knowledge management for Obsidian vaults and structured markdown repositories

devlog_mode.title: Devlog mode
devlog_mode.description: Who writes devlog entries: 'nudge' asks the main agent at session start (default), 'sidechain' judges turns from a background fork of the transcript, 'both' runs both (for comparing).

park_in_vault.title: Park in vault
park_in_vault.description: Make agent-meta's park and unpark keep handoffs in a second-brain vault (its CLAUDE.md '## Parking' section sets the folder). Turn off to keep them in .parkinglot/.

park_vault.title: Park vault
park_vault.description: Directory for agent-meta's park and unpark handoffs. Leave empty to use your default vault from ~/.claude/second-brain.md. A '~' at the start is expanded.
